scientific_conclusion: Observable post-offset residual and modulation-smearing manifestations are measured without room-parameter claims.
Signed tail excess, bounded persistence, conditional decay and pinned SRMR measure their stated observables and reconstruct from saved evidence.
Natural primary-speech offsets, independent late floors, global DC removal, exact media hashes and pinned SRMR identity are verified.
Gain, polarity, DC, common shift, source-rate, codec and duration behavior satisfy the declared contracts.
RIR-dose, known-persistence and exponential-decay simulations show expected responses in the declared operating range.
Breathing, residual articulation, changing noise floors, delayed echo and additive noise remain plausible confounds or non-identifiable alternatives.
Support, censoring and missingness are explicit. The 2/3/4 classes describe evidence quantity, not calibrated precision.
Tail excess, persistence and SRMR show moderate repeated-recording persistence; decay is sparse and more parameter-sensitive.
Units, orientations, conditional availability, censoring and non-independence are explicit.
No scalar, room-parameter estimate, event detector, standalone reject gate or operational threshold is authorized.
